record-compact-constructor.title: Record compact constructors
record-compact-constructor.short: Validate record components without repeating the parameter list
record-compact-constructor.summary: Use a compact constructor to validate or normalize record components.
record-compact-constructor.why: A compact constructor keeps record invariants close to the declaration while Java assigns the validated components automatically.
record-compact-constructor.tips: Validate or normalize component variables in the body; do not assign record fields directly.

sealed-classes-basics.title: Sealed classes and interfaces
sealed-classes-basics.short: Restrict which types may extend or implement a type
sealed-classes-basics.summary: Use sealed types to define a closed set of permitted direct subtypes.
sealed-classes-basics.why: A sealed hierarchy makes the intended subtype set explicit and can support exhaustive reasoning such as pattern switches.
sealed-classes-basics.tips: Permitted direct subtypes must follow Java's sealed hierarchy rules and declare an appropriate final, sealed, or non-sealed status.

map-compute-if-present.title: Update an existing Map value
map-compute-if-present.short: Use computeIfPresent only when a key has a value
map-compute-if-present.summary: Recompute a map entry when its key is currently associated with a non-null value.
map-compute-if-present.why: computeIfPresent combines the presence check and value update into one Map operation.
map-compute-if-present.tips: Remember that returning null from the remapping function removes the mapping.

string-repeat-count.title: Repeat a string
string-repeat-count.summary: Repeat a string a specified number of times without a manual loop.
string-repeat-count.why: String.repeat expresses repeated fixed text directly and avoids mutable builder boilerplate for simple cases.
string-repeat-count.tips: The count must be non-negative; an empty string or a count of zero produces an empty string.

localdate-parse-format.title: LocalDate format mismatch
localdate-parse-format.short: Date text does not match the expected format
localdate-parse-format.summary: Handle invalid text passed to LocalDate.parse.
localdate-parse-format.why: The default parser expects an ISO date, so differently formatted input results in DateTimeParseException.
localdate-parse-format.tips: Choose an explicit DateTimeFormatter when accepting a format other than the default ISO representation.

foreach-remove-concurrent-modification.title: Removing from a List during for-each
foreach-remove-concurrent-modification.short: Do not structurally modify a collection through the wrong path while iterating
foreach-remove-concurrent-modification.summary: Avoid calling List.remove on the same list during a for-each traversal.
foreach-remove-concurrent-modification.why: Fail-fast iterators detect unexpected structural modification and throw ConcurrentModificationException.
foreach-remove-concurrent-modification.tips: Use removeIf for conditional removal, or Iterator.remove when iterating explicitly.

invalid-multi-catch-related-types.title: Related alternatives in multi-catch
invalid-multi-catch-related-types.short: A multi-catch cannot contain a type and its subtype
invalid-multi-catch-related-types.summary: Do not place related exception types in the same multi-catch alternatives list.
invalid-multi-catch-related-types.why: Catching a superclass already covers its subclass, so listing both as alternatives is redundant and rejected by the compiler.
invalid-multi-catch-related-types.tips: Catch the common superclass once, or use separate catches only when distinct handling is required and legal.

sealed-class-not-permitted.title: Subtype is not permitted by a sealed type
sealed-class-not-permitted.short: Direct subtypes must be allowed by the sealed hierarchy
sealed-class-not-permitted.summary: Add intended direct subtypes to a sealed type's permitted set and give them a valid modifier.
sealed-class-not-permitted.why: Sealed types deliberately restrict direct inheritance, so an undeclared implementation cannot join the hierarchy.
sealed-class-not-permitted.tips: Keep the permits list and the direct subtype declarations synchronized when changing the hierarchy.

serial-version-uid-warning.title: Missing serialVersionUID warning
serial-version-uid-warning.short: Declare a stable serialization version identifier when needed
serial-version-uid-warning.summary: Give Serializable classes an explicit serialVersionUID when using Java serialization intentionally.
serial-version-uid-warning.why: Compilers and analysis tools can warn when a Serializable class relies on an automatically computed identifier that may change with class details.
serial-version-uid-warning.tips: Treat Java serialization carefully for long-lived data; an explicit identifier does not by itself guarantee schema compatibility.

mutable-key-hashmap.title: Mutable keys in HashMap
mutable-key-hashmap.short: Do not change fields used by equals or hashCode after insertion
mutable-key-hashmap.summary: Keep hash-based map keys stable while they are stored in the map.
mutable-key-hashmap.why: Changing a key's hash-relevant state can move its logical hash location without moving the stored entry, making later lookup fail unexpectedly.
mutable-key-hashmap.tips: Prefer immutable key objects and base equals and hashCode only on stable identity data.
